[3/7] Cloudflare

[4/7] Google
Google sign-in identifies your users and creators.
Create a Web application OAuth client.
Public pebbles work without Google; you can set it up later.
https://console.cloud.google.com/auth/clients/create
Application type: Web application
Authorized redirect URI: https://auth.example.com/callback
✓ Redirect URI copied
Consent screen: External; publish the app (Audience → Publish app → In production) so friends can sign in.
Bedrock requests only openid, email and profile; no Google scope verification is needed.
Alternative: keep Testing and add test users for a development app. Google allows basic identity scopes without test-user listing, but check a non-test account before sharing.
Doctor cannot detect your Google publishing status.
https://console.cloud.google.com/auth/audience
Google client ID (or skip) [skip]: 123-test.apps.googleusercontent.com
Google client secret: [hidden]
✓ Google sign-in configured

✓ Backups configured

[7/7] Verify
✓ Doctor passed
Sign in once as creator@example.com: https://bedrock.example.com
Type skip to defer sign-in; setup checks automatically: 
✓ Creator sign-in verified
Check friend access: open a pebble with access: "users" in a private window and sign in with a Google account absent from your test-user list; doctor cannot check this.

┌ You're live
│ https://bedrock.example.com
